description: Election Commission - Supplementary Register of Electors 2018
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically concerns electoral processes - the preparation of a Supplementary Register of Electors for internally displaced Sri Lankan citizens who haven't been registered elsewhere. It outlines procedures for appeals and objections related to voter registration, mentions the Election Commission, and references the Registration of Electors (Special Provisions) Act. This falls squarely under election-related matters including voter registration procedures.
